broker.name: Tickmill
broker.tagline: Its site names 5 regulators, including FSA (Seychelles), FCA, and DFSA. Rules depend on where you live. Advertised leverage: Up to 1:1000.
broker.about: The Tickmill pages checked on 11 October 2026 do not state a founding year or one headquarters. Account names on its site include Classic, Raw, TradingView Raw, and Futures. Platforms named there include MetaTrader 4, MetaTrader 5, TradingView, and Tickmill Trader. The site names these regulators: FSA (Seychelles), FCA, DFSA, CySEC, and FSCA. The company on an account depends on where the client lives. Minimum deposit is not a single number on the pages that loaded. The highest leverage figure taken from those pages is Up to 1:1000. Leverage increases losses as well as gains.
broker.regulators_note: The company behind an account depends on where you live. FSA (Seychelles): Tickmill Ltd, SD008. FCA: Tickmill UK Ltd, 717270. DFSA: Tickmill UK Ltd (representative office), F007663. CySEC: Tickmill Europe Ltd, 278/15. FSCA: Tickmill South Africa (Pty) Ltd, FSP 49464.

broker.leverage_note: Leverage increases losses as well as gains, and you can lose more than you deposit. The highest figure on this card is the highest number this broker advertises. It is not the cap on every account. The cap depends on the company, the product and where you live.

other_fees.label: Minimum deposit
other_fees.note: Not one number. Accounts overview: starting deposit 100 for Classic, Raw and TradingView Raw, and the page says the starting deposit may vary by base currency. The same page says Classic and Raw require a $100 minimum deposit and Futures accounts require a $1,000 minimum deposit. The EU FAQ says the starting deposit for all account types is $100 and may vary by base currency.

other_fees.label: Withdrawals
other_fees.note: Deposit and withdrawal page: Tickmill charges zero withdrawal fees. Intermediary banks or e-wallet providers may charge. FAQ also says no transfer fees on deposit and withdrawal methods.

other_fees.label: Bank wire deposit fee rebate
other_fees.note: Deposits from USD 5,000 or equivalent in a single bank wire are covered by a Zero Fees Policy. Proof must be emailed. The page reserves a right to charge an inactivity fee.

other_fees.label: Inactivity fee, Tickmill Europe Ltd
other_fees.note: CySEC client agreement: charged on a dormant Client Area. If the wallet is at or below that amount, the remainder is written off.

other_fees.label: Inactivity fee and withdrawal commission, Tickmill Ltd
other_fees.value: 10 USD/EUR/GBP/CHF or 40 PLN quarterly; withdrawal commission up to 5.2%
other_fees.note: Seychelles client service agreement: same quarterly dormant fee. It also reserves a right to raise commission on withdrawal up to 5.2% if there is not sufficient trading activity between the last deposit and the withdrawal request.

_notes.fetch_notes: Homepage, accounts and licences pages fetched. Tickmill Europe Ltd incorporation on 29 January 2015 is the Cyprus entity, not a stated group founding date. Homepage says 12+ years experience, which is not a year. Homepage also shows EUR 120,000 FSCS protection, while the licences page says UK clients are protected up to GBP 120,000 per person through the FSCS. EU ICF cover on the licences page is 90% of an eligible claim up to 20,000 euros. Registered addresses differ between the licences page, the footer and the CySEC company-information PDF. No trading bonus was found on the pages fetched.
